verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has its own data-egress features. Business and Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data beyond Honeybadger's retention (docs-22), though the snippet is truncated and names no destination or format. A Faults API returns lists of faults per project (docs-19), so error data can be pulled out programmatically. There is no documented one-click full-account export, and open formats are not confirmed. Missing for 10: a documented complete export covering all data types (errors, notices, check-ins, uptime, Insights), explicit open-format output (e.g., JSON/CSV/Parquet), replication available on all plans, and independent corroboration of a successful export-and-leave migration.
